item.title: Fire-Displaced Sneakerhead Finds New Home
item.description: A week and a day after a fire displaced dozens of tenants from a now-city-condemned Chapel Street apartment building, Christopher Schroeder began moving his belongings -- including box after box of Air Jordans, Adidas, and New Balance sneakers -- into his new apartment with the help of a long-time friend. item.title: Students Return To Hartford For $chools Push
item.description: HARTFORD — Metropolitan Business Academy senior Bayan Albakkour took the bus Wednesday morning not to school, but to the state's capital city, where she delivered a message to the Connecticut legislature alongside more than 100 of her peers: New Haven Public Schools needs more money.
